channel.title: Potomac Local News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Potomac Local News (potomaclocal.com)

item.title: Virginia Health Department Partially Lifts Potomac River Advisory
item.description: The Virginia Department of Health (VDH) announced that it is partially lifting a recreational water advisory for the Potomac River, effective immediately.

item.title: Paws for Healing: SNVMC’s Therapy Dog Program Grows to Five, Bringing Comfort to Patients and Staff
item.description: Sentara Northern Virginia Medical Center (SNVMC) has expanded its therapy dog program from one to five certified therapy dogs over the past year.

item.title: Salvation Army Relocates to Woodbridge Shopping Center
item.description: The Salvation Army has successfully relocated its thrift store from its former site in Gordon Plaza to a prominent new space at Woodbridge Shopping Center, strengthening its presence in the community.

item.title: Your Water Bill Could Rise: Stafford Advances Rate Increases While Data Centers Help Pay for New Pipes
item.description: The Stafford County Board of Supervisors unanimously authorized advertising public hearings on March 3, 2026, for proposed adjustments to water, sewer, and reclaimed water rates, including new fees designed to recover costs from data center-related infrastructure while introducing equity measures for commercial users.

item.title: Student Makes Farm Bureau History
item.description: A Brentsville District High School senior has become the first high school student in the nation to serve as chair of a county Farm Bureau committee, according to Prince William County Public Schools.

item.title: Business Leaders Invited to Manassas Reception
item.description: The Northern Virginia Hispanic Chamber of Commerce will host a networking reception next month in Manassas as the organization expands its presence into Prince William County.

item.title: Stafford County Schools Adjust Calendar for April 21 Special Election on Congressional Redistricting
item.description: Stafford County Public Schools (SCPS) has announced changes to the 2025-2026 academic calendar to accommodate the state's special election on April 21, 2026, when 22 local schools will serve as polling locations.

item.title: Two Killed In Woodbridge Wrong Way Crash
item.description: Prince William County police are investigating a fatal crash that killed two Woodbridge residents Sunday evening.

item.title: Woodbridge District Supervisor Special Election Set for Tuesday, March 10, 2026
item.description: Prince William County voters in the Woodbridge Magisterial District head to the polls tomorrow, Tuesday, March 10, 2026, in a special election to fill a vacancy on the Prince William County Board of Supervisors.

item.title: Hansford Wins Back Job: Arbitrator Slams PWCS for Union Discrimination in Hiring Denial
item.description: In a decision that underscores the protections afforded to union leaders under Virginia’s collective bargaining laws, a neutral arbitrator has ruled that Prince William County Public Schools (PWCS) committed unfair labor practices by refusing to rehire former Prince William Education Association (PWEA) President Mary “Maggie” Hansford in August 2025.
